types.name: polyester.api.MFARequirement
types.doc: MFARequirement describes the interactive MFA assurance documented for an RPC.

values.name: MFA_RECENT
values.doc: The RPC requires a recently MFA-elevated interactive session.

values.name: MFA_FRESH_STEP_UP
values.doc: The RPC requires a fresh, single-use step-up proof.

values.name: MFA_CONDITIONAL
values.doc: The RPC's MFA requirement depends on the caller or request.
